args.prompt:
Create high-resolution production sprite animation for the existing Bagseed game, preserving the supplied original character identity exactly. Output FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. One isolated COMPLETE FULL BODY figure per cell, head/hair/hands/shoes/prop fully inside each cell with generous margins. Eight DIFFERENT chronological poses of ONE continuous walk cycle in ONE direction; row2 CONTINUES the SAME direction as row1. Do not turn around in row2. No labels, grid, background, cast shadows, extra people, portraits or decorative elements. Consistent figure scale, head size and hip center every cell, same floor baseline, only slight weight bob. High resolution delicate illustrated linework, coherent curls, subtle fabric folds and clear fingers as the original source; NOT pixelated, not thick comic borders, not blurred painted blobs, not a new chibi redesign. First reference is the exact identity and view; second is the original identity in all views, third shows the approved EIGHT-PHASE motion standard (body-only sample, use its gait, not its outfit). Eight consecutive poses, read across row1 then row2: 1 first foot heel contact, opposite foot back toe contact; 2 weight loading onto first leg, other heel lifts for toe-off; 3 first leg straight supporting under hip, other leg BENT at knee and its foot lifted clear of the ground passing forward; 4 first leg pushes off behind, other knee/foot reaches forward still raised; 5 OPPOSITE foot heel contact in front and first foot back; 6 weight loading onto opposite leg, first heel lifts behind; 7 opposite leg supporting under hip, first leg bent raised passing; 8 opposite leg pushes off behind, first leg reaches forward raised ready for frame1. Arms oppose legs. The camera-near leg is not always the front leg: its foot must travel front → under hip → behind → lifted past → front over the ENTIRE eight-pose loop. No duplicated four-pose half loop.
ONLY CHARACTER: REMY ALVAREZ: warm tan skin, thick round dark brown curly hair, square brown glasses, mustard yellow short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal shorts, visible bare lower legs, brown strapped sandals. Preserve the existing face, compact proportions, hair volume and glasses.
DIRECTION: ALL EIGHT figures face screen RIGHT in strict RIGHT PROFILE. Nose and shoe toes point RIGHT. Both rows face RIGHT. Never mirror or rotate the second half. Use the body-only motion reference's eight distinct side phases.
